label: Kuaishou
terms_note: Kuaishou Open Platform account (企业 developer for content publishing), per-capability application + review; user OAuth (快手登录) with scopes user_info, user_video_publish, user_video_info; published limit (research: 1,000 publishes per user per day); Kuaishou platform rules against spam / batch marketing accounts.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.endpoint: — (no text post; `caption` rides on a video)

tools.name: publish_image
tools.endpoint: — (图文 publishing not modelled by our client; existence unverified)

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.endpoint: — (no comment API modelled; existence unverified — see UNREACHABLE note)

auth: 1. 入驻 as a developer (enterprise for content publishing), create a 网站 / 移动 application, apply for capabilities

endpoints.call: callback URL for 授权事件 / 解除授权事件

reference.limits: - Research value: 1,000 publishes per user per day; the exact per-app quotas live in the console. - Kuaishou platform rules against batch marketing accounts and spam; enterprise onboarding.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: app_id of your Kuaishou Open Platform application (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: app_secret of the same application; sent only to /oauth2/refresh_token.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: The user's refresh_token from the 快手登录 authorization-code exchange (/oauth2/access_token, scopes user_info, user_video_info, user_video_delete; valid 180 days). It is single-use: every refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set; 'refreshToken.discarded' means an old one was reused).

me.note: GET /openapi/user_info (scope user_info): name, sex, fan, follow, head, city of the authorising user.

delete.note: POST /openapi/photo/delete (删除视频) removes one of the user's works by photo_id; 120001 = work does not exist.

analytics_post.note: GET /openapi/photo/info (查询单一视频详情, scope user_video_info): like_count, comment_count, view_count, caption, create_time (ms), pending.

not_offered.publish_text: Kuaishou's content API publishes videos only (视频发布, https://open.kuaishou.com/platform/openApi?menu=20: start_upload → binary/multipart upload → publish); there is no text post.
not_offered.publish_image: Only video works can be published (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform/openApi?menu=20), via a binary or multipart file upload; no image-by-URL post exists.
not_offered.read_comments: The 内容管理 APIs (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform/openApi?menu=22) return comment_count only; no comment list endpoint is documented.
not_offered.reply_comment: No comment API is documented in the Kuaishou Open Platform content-management section (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform/openApi?menu=22).

adapter.terms: Kuaishou Open Platform: every OpenAPI call carries app_id and access_token as query parameters; result = 1 is success, anything else carries error_msg. Access tokens last 48 h and are minted from the rotating refresh_token.

evidence: host open.kuaishou.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (public), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
